correctness.rationale: A full symbolic proof independently identifies the intrinsic rank-one multiplication subspaces W_i from nonsingularity of the base adjacency. An isomorphism permutes these blocks, induces a base automorphism by comparing supports of independent U_i, and satisfies s_j=lambda_i along edges and s_i^2=lambda_i d_i by Euclidean block similitudes. Even-walk propagation forces constant degrees (nonbipartite) or bipartition-wise constant degrees; explicit real diagonal maps give the converse. The independent exact-rational checker confirms rank computations for 117 finite examples and 3480 rank trials; these are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The source 2017 theorem proves the iff statement when the FULL graph adjacency is invertible, while the present theorem works for all independent-set blow-ups of invertible bases, with unbounded original adjacency nullity. The 2024 singular-graphs work proves nonisomorphism or stronger absence of nonzero homomorphisms for particular tree families; these special cases overlap but do not imply a classification for arbitrary invertible-quotient blow-ups or complete multipartite graphs. The 2026 survey still formulates the singular converse as Question 26. Actual claim-level indexed and literature searches disclosed no general matching theorem. Residual unindexed-coverage risk is not claimed eliminated.
residual_risks: Equivalent results could exist in unindexed papers, theses, or differently named twin-reduction frameworks.

value.rationale: This gives a necessary-and-sufficient isomorphism criterion for a natural infinite family of singular graph evolution algebras with arbitrarily large adjacency nullity, building on the explicit open singular-graph converse and extending the 2017 nonsingular theorem in a structurally nontrivial way. The rank-one multiplication-locus technique yields a general invariant recovering twin blocks. A complete-multipartite classification follows immediately but is part of a larger motivated theorem.
